name: Trans Mountain Pipeline Expansion
description: Twinning of existing pipeline from Edmonton to Burnaby, tripling capacity to 890,000 bpd.

statusHistory.detail: While the Trans Mountain Pipeline Expansion project was completed in May 2024, Trans Mountain has applied to the Canada Energy Regulator to implement drag reducing agents (DRA) to increase the pipeline's capacity by up to 10%. Construction for this optimization is expected to begin in August 2026 and be operational by January 2027. Additionally, the Port of Vancouver has applied to dredge Burrard Inlet to allow full loading of tankers at the Westridge Marine Terminal, with work anticipated until February 2027.
